mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.4% signals an aggressive monetary policy easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.4% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% triggers a recessionary panic phase where investors sell equities for cash, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market collapse, triggering equity sell-offs that produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint PAYEMS decline/UNRATE rise signal fails to predict negative returns when correlation with SPX returns is < 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 750k units signals a collapsing consumer spending engine, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as economic activity contracts.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 50% of instances when HOUST < 750.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering short-term equity sell-offs that produce negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 215.0 signals inflationary pressure that forces central bank rate hikes, causing equity discount rate increases and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 11700) and housing starts decline (HOUST < 800) indicates deepening economic recession, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The GDPC1 decline/HOUST decline joint signal fails to predict negative returns when correlation with SPX returns is < 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 350,000 million dollars signals strong consumer confidence, driving equity valuation expansion that produces positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > 350000.
